dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001196\_46](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001196) Category 2 during the period Aug 11 2025-Aug 22 2025 in Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, Turks and Caicos Islands, Virgin Islands British, United States, Bahamas, Canada, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Bermuda, Anguilla, Virgin Islands U.S., Iceland, Ireland, United Kingdom, Faroe Islands. The center of the storm was located near latitude 40.0 longitude -59.7. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
